# telnyx_ai_test_personalities (Data Source)

The personalities that simulated users take on in AI test framework scenarios.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ai_test_personalities` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_test_personalities))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_test_personalities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_test_personalities`

Read-Only:

- `accent` (String)
- `background_noise` (String)
- `background_sound_volume` (Number)
- `effective_voice_volume` (Number)
- `end_call_enabled` (Boolean)
- `forked_from` (Number) ID of the personality this one was forked from.
- `generation_config` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `id` (Number)
- `interruption_level` (String) How aggressively the personality interrupts the assistant.
- `language` (String) ISO language code the simulated caller speaks.
- `message_plan` (String) Idle-timeout plan for messages during a call. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `name` (String) Display name of the personality.
- `network_simulation` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `organization` (Number)
- `project` (Number)
- `prompt` (String) Instructions the simulated caller follows.
- `speed` (Number)
- `start_speaking_plan` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `stop_speaking_plan` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `voice_volume` (Number)
